mainStatements.sectionComment: Groupe de ressources principal : registre d’images partagé.
mainStatements.template:
module acrMainModule '{{moduleReference}}' = if (acrMain.deploy) {
  name: 'acrMain-${target.code}-${uniqueString(acrMain.name)}'
  scope: rg_main
  params: {
    name: acrMain.name
    location: acrMain.location
    acrSku: acrMain.acrSku
    acrAdminUserEnabled: acrMain.adminUserEnabled
    anonymousPullEnabled: acrMain.anonymousPullEnabled
    publicNetworkAccess: acrMain.publicNetworkAccess
    networkRuleSetDefaultAction: acrMain.networkRuleSetDefaultAction
    tags: acrMain.tags
    diagnosticSettings: []
    enableTelemetry: false
  }
}
